C0492.title: Guangdong Shantou Chen Moucai Used AI to Bypass Douyin Facial Recognition Case
keywords: Ministry of Public Security typical cases
C0492.summary: In May 2023, Shantou police found that suspect Chen Moucai and others had purchased citizens' personal information and used overseas AI face technology software to turn facial photos into videos, bypassing Douyin's live-person verification process and illegally registering real-name online accounts. On July 5, 2023, Shantou cyber police, under unified Guangdong provincial command, carried out arrests in Shenzhen, Jieyang, Shantou and other places, detained seven suspects, and seized more than 10,000 Douyin accounts involving over 600,000 yuan.
